about_item: Open-Ear Headphones - Experience unmatched comfort with our lightweight, secure fit, featuring an earbud-free design for all-day listening without ear fatigue.(Rebranded version of AfterShokz OpenMove)
Safety & Connection - Stay motivated with your favorite audio without compromising on safety. Unlike over-ear and in-ear headphones, OpenMove keeps you connected and aware of your surroundings.

Secure Fit - From light jogs to everyday commutes, a wraparound titanium frame keeps your bone conduction headphones in place during a range of low impact activities.A rugged, sweat-resistant design built to withstand your most intense workouts.

6 Hours of Music & Calls - Enjoy six continuous hours of music, calls, and podcasts on a single charge with our bluetooth headphones. Universal compatibility: Seamlessly pairs with Android, iOS, Windows, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices.Includes a USB-C cable.

High Sound Quality- Enjoy balanced audio, optimal volume and rich bass delivered through your cheekbone, anytime, anywhere with this premium OpenMove headset.Ensures excellent call quality for clear conversations.

summary.text: Customers find these headphones have amazing sound quality, good noise cancellation that allows them to hear their surroundings, and are well worth the price. The comfort and fit receive mixed feedback - while some say they sit comfortably on the head, others find them extremely uncomfortable and too large for their head. Moreover, reliability and battery life are also mixed aspects, with some saying they work well and have exceptional battery life, while others report them stopping working or not lasting as long as expected.
